strength.name: Strength Training Program
strength.goal: Build muscle mass, increase raw strength, and improve compound lift performance.
strength.description: A structured 12-week program focusing on compound strength movements, progressive overload, and hypertrophy phases for maximum muscle development.

progression_plan.weeks_1_4: Focus on form and consistency; moderate weight, 3x8-10 reps.
progression_plan.weeks_5_8: Increase volume and intensity; 4x6-8 reps on compounds.
progression_plan.weeks_9_12: Strength phase with heavier loads; 5x5 on main lifts.

strength.nutrition_guidelines: Caloric surplus with 1.6–2.2g protein/kg bodyweight, high-carb pre-workout meals.

days.focus: Volume Training for Chest, Back, and Arms

weight_loss.name: Weight Loss & Conditioning Program
weight_loss.goal: Maximize calorie burn, improve endurance, and promote fat loss while maintaining lean muscle.
weight_loss.description: This high-intensity program combines strength, cardio, and HIIT elements to accelerate fat loss and improve conditioning.

progression_plan.weeks_1_2: Learn form and pacing with moderate intensity.
progression_plan.weeks_3_5: Increase intensity and reduce rest times.
progression_plan.weeks_6_8: Advanced interval combinations and higher resistance.

weight_loss.nutrition_guidelines: Caloric deficit (10-20%), high protein intake, balanced complex carbs and healthy fats.

general_fitness.name: General Fitness & Wellness Program
general_fitness.goal: Improve overall health, endurance, and body composition with a balanced weekly routine.
general_fitness.split: Full Body Split (5 Days per Week)
general_fitness.description: An adaptable full-body routine that combines strength, cardio, and mobility to promote long-term wellness and fitness balance.

progression_plan.weeks_1_3: Establish consistency and build baseline endurance.
progression_plan.weeks_4_7: Increase difficulty with more volume and shorter rest periods.
progression_plan.weeks_8_10: Add progressive overload and flexibility challenges.

general_fitness.nutrition_guidelines: Balanced diet with adequate hydration and 1.2–1.5g protein/kg bodyweight.

mobility_rehab.name: Mobility & Rehab Program
mobility_rehab.goal: Enhance joint mobility, posture, and movement efficiency while aiding recovery.
mobility_rehab.description: Perfect for recovery or beginners returning to training. Focuses on flexibility, stability, and body control.

progression_plan.weeks_1_2: Gentle range of motion and foundational balance work.
progression_plan.weeks_3_4: Add light resistance and stability challenges.
progression_plan.weeks_5_6: Progress to dynamic mobility and flow-based sessions.

mobility_rehab.nutrition_guidelines: Focus on anti-inflammatory foods, adequate protein, and hydration.
